text_simplified: Creed and faith are the foundation upon which all other deeds are built, as in the parable of the good word likened to a good tree whose root is firm; if its root is cut, the tree dies, and likewise religion if it is not built on tawheed. For this reason, many texts emphasize establishing creed in children's hearts from a young age. The first thing Luqman counseled his son was to forbid shirk, because it is the gravest of sins and nullifies all deeds.
